specification.shape: Linear; first sample advances 1/N, sample N is exact target; retarget from current gain; identical target does not restart.

specification.automation: Existing block target treatment is retained. This is per-sample output smoothing, not scheduling all host automation points at their sample offsets.
specification.threading: Live interpolation is audio-owned and allocation/lock-free. Host restore remains a quiescent lifecycle operation under the existing contract.
